title: Digitization as a factor in improving business performance
rationale: Conceptual essay on digitalisation and business performance; no LLM agent, process model, or compliance mechanism.

title: Inovação e gestão no poder judiciário: uma abordagem empírica com Inteligência Artificial Generativa para otimização e gestão de riscos de processos
rationale: On-topic BPMN/XPDL plus Gemini judiciary tool, but the abstract is Portuguese, so the preregistered non-English exclusion applies.

title: Introduction to Large Language Models in Business Analytics
rationale: Broad book-chapter overview of LLMs in business analytics; no agent control mechanism or empirical process result.

title: Integrating Lightweight Large Language Models into ERP Systems: A Demonstrative Implementation in ERPNext
rationale: Local lightweight LLM wired into ERPNext with a prompt and response-filtering pipeline, demonstrated on a sales-order procedure.

title: ProcessGPT: Transforming Business Process Management with Generative Artificial Intelligence
rationale: Position paper proposing GPT-generated process models for BPM; frames LLM-driven process automation but reports no evaluation.

title: Mobile Edge Intelligence for Large Language Models: A Contemporary Survey
rationale: Survey of edge deployment of LLMs; concerns inference infrastructure, not process compliance or agent control.

title: Utilizing domain knowledge in data-driven process discovery: A literature review
rationale: Pre-LLM review of domain knowledge and constraints injected into process discovery; anchors the deterministic process-model baseline.

title: Security of Internet of Agents: Attacks and Countermeasures
rationale: Survey of attacks and defence mechanisms for interacting LLM agents; adjacent control and trust mechanisms, not process compliance.

title: The extended EA ModelSet—a FAIR dataset for researching and reasoning enterprise architecture modeling practices
rationale: FAIR ArchiMate model dataset for AI-based enterprise architecture research; background resource, not a control mechanism.

title: An Egocentric Life-Saving Interventional Procedure Dataset of Actions, Medical Questions, Maneuvers and Tools
rationale: Egocentric surgical video dataset for medical action recognition; wrong field and no organizational process.

title: FlowMind: Automatic Workflow Generation with LLMs
rationale: LLM workflow generation grounded in vetted APIs to curb hallucination and data exposure, evaluated against baseline and ablation variants.

title: InjecAgent: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injections in Tool-Integrated Large Language Model Agents
rationale: Benchmark of indirect prompt injection over 30 tool-using agents; quantifies instruction-following failure as a reliability limitation.

title: Learning business process simulation models: A Hybrid process mining and deep learning approach
rationale: Pre-LLM hybrid process mining and deep learning simulation models; background on data-driven process model fidelity.

title: Can I Trust My Simulation Model? Measuring the Quality of Business Process Simulation Models
rationale: Pre-LLM quality measures comparing simulated behaviour with observed logs; background on measuring model-to-behaviour conformance.

title: What Questions Can I Ask? A Taxonomy and Question Catalog for Process Mining Analysis Questions
rationale: Taxonomy and catalogue of process mining analysis questions; background on BPM analysis practice, with no agent or control mechanism.

title: LLM-driven Data Service Discovery in the Internet of Production
rationale: RAG over a catalogue of atomic data services constrains LLM pipeline design, with preliminary smart-factory case-study evaluation.

title: Robotic Process Automation and Artificial Intelligence in Industry 4.0 – A Literature review
rationale: Pre-LLM review of RPA plus AI in Industry 4.0; background on deterministic automation of organizational processes.

title: An AI-augmented Framework for Automated and Intelligent Process Monitoring
rationale: AI framework interpreting user actions into process-management-system progress updates, demonstrated in a manufacturing case study.

title: Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for Process Mining (Technical Report)
rationale: Empirical assessment of prompting strategies for LLM interpretation of declarative and procedural process models with GPT-4 and Bard.

title: Business process improvement with AB testing and reinforcement learning: grounded theory-based industry perspectives
rationale: Grounded-theory industry study of AB testing and RL for process improvement; finds expert control over autonomous production experiments necessary.

title: Towards Responsible Generative AI: A Reference Architecture for Designing Foundation Model Based Agents
rationale: Pattern-oriented reference architecture for foundation-model agents covering accountability and security, validated by mapping to two real agents.

title: A comparative study of LLMs and NLP approaches for supporting business process analysis
rationale: Empirical comparison of LLM and NLP extraction of business process knowledge elements; enriched prompts outperform, quantifying prompt effects.

title: AIKernel Semantic DSL Compiler and Deterministic Agent Execution Architecture
rationale: Abstract describes the AutoGen multi-agent framework, where conversation patterns are programmed in natural language or code with human and tool steps.

title: Learning Accurate Business Process Simulation Models from Event Logs via Automated Process Discovery and Deep Learning
rationale: Earlier conference version of the hybrid data-driven and deep learning process simulation approach; background on process model fidelity.

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Management System Adaptability, Agility and Resilience: Mapping the Research Agenda
rationale: Bibliometric mapping of AI and management-system agility; no agent, process model, or compliance evaluation.

title: "If the Machine Is As Good As Me, Then What Use Am I?" – How the Use of ChatGPT Changes Young Professionals' Perception of Productivity and Accomplishment
rationale: Diary study of ChatGPT effects on perceived productivity in knowledge work; human-factors background rather than process control.

title: MathChat: Converse to Tackle Challenging Math Problems with LLM Agents
rationale: LLM agent conversation framework evaluated on competition mathematics; no organizational process or policy constraint.

title: Augmented Reality for Maintenance Tasks with ChatGPT for Automated Text-to-Action
rationale: AR plus GPT assistant guiding human maintenance procedures; measures task time and trust, so background rather than agent process control.

title: Human-guided collective LLM intelligence for strategic planning via two-stage information retrieval
rationale: Only a truncated publisher teaser ending mid-word; no usable abstract text to screen.

title: The Power of Noise: Redefining Retrieval for RAG Systems
rationale: Empirical study of how retrieved context relevance and noise change LLM accuracy; a limitation for grounding policy text in prompts.

title: Supervised learning of process discovery techniques using graph neural networks
rationale: Supervised GNN process discovery producing sound Petri nets; pre-LLM background on process model generation.

title: Orca: Progressive Learning from Complex Explanation Traces of GPT-4
rationale: Explanation-trace imitation tuning of a smaller model; model training scope with no process or compliance element.

title: Process Mining over Multiple Behavioral Dimensions with Event Knowledge Graphs
rationale: Event knowledge graphs for multi-entity process mining; pre-LLM background on process behaviour representation.

title: Sketch2Process: End-to-End BPMN Sketch Recognition Based on Neural Networks
rationale: Neural recognition of hand-drawn BPMN sketches; pre-LLM process model tooling background.

title: AI Chains: Transparent and Controllable Human-AI Interaction by Chaining Large Language Model Prompts
rationale: User study showing chained LLM prompt steps improve outcome quality, transparency, and controllability versus unchained monolithic use.
